name: apaar-setu
description: APAAR Setu - AICTE Verified Student Register prototype (MERN, synthetic data only). Convenience scripts for the server/ and client/ packages.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
